rows.en: A mobile suit...!! So it's a Hi-Zack...!!
There's another one...!! OOO!! Handle this one for me!!
...Understood!! Leave it to me, Nu Gundam!!
But why would a kaijin be here...?
That was a close call, huh?
Sorry 'bout that. You saved my skin...
But you two... who are you?
I'm Nu Gundam. And he is...
Gundam? Kamen Rider? Never heard those names before...
Can't blame you. We only just met a little while ago ourselves.
We have no idea where this place is... or even why we're here.
I see... So we're in the same boat. I just came to and found myself here, too.
I'm Zero. Ultraman Zero. Good to meet ya.
...These tremors have been going on for a while now.
Either way, it's dangerous here. Let's search the area as we move.
Zero, will you come with us?
Ultraman Zero, Nu Gundam and Kamen Rider OOO set out together.
What is this thing!? I've never seen one before!!
Eleking swung its mighty tail around with brute force!!
What power!! I never thought Eleking would be this strong...!!
OOO! Zero! Now we've got no choice but to fight. Let's combine the strength of all three of us!!
The gap in power is way too big!!
Forget Emerium Slash, I can't even use my Zero Sluggers!!
I hate to admit it... but the way we are now, it doesn't look like we can beat this thing...
This is bad...!! We're getting out of here!!
Hah... hah... We should be safe now that we've come this far...
Something's strange... about the way we're wearing out.
But I've figured it out. The enemy didn't get stronger...
We're the ones who've lost our power.
My Tatoba Kick wouldn't come out either... Ah, I mean, I couldn't pull off my usual moves.
Yeah. Some of the enemies I've fought come from other dimensions, after all.
Other dimensions...? That's hard to believe, but if it's true, are there enemies in there?
No... but somehow, I feel strangely calm...
Look, from the other side of the hole... Can't you feel it?
...You're right. What is this? This feels so nostalgic...
Maybe what's beyond here connects back to our own world!!
You're right. Let's go! Into the hole!
